title: Pigment — Color System Studio
description: Build a real colour system in OKLCH — tonal ramps, harmony, a 12×12 contrast grid, a live UI preview and token exports.
concept: Pigment is the colour tool a design system actually needs, as one offline HTML file. Seven ramps of twelve stops are generated in OKLCH from a hue, a chroma curve, hue torsion and a lightness bend, with every stop gamut-mapped by chroma reduction into sRGB or Display P3. A hue wheel and six harmony schemes place the accent and support hues; a 12×12 matrix scores every background/ink pair in both WCAG 2.2 and APCA; a mock dashboard repaints itself from your tokens so a bad ramp looks bad immediately; and the whole system exports as CSS custom properties, oklch(), Tailwind colours, W3C design tokens, an SVG swatch sheet or a PNG.
features: OKLCH ramp engine — hue, peak chroma, chroma spread and peak position, hue torsion, lightness bend and end stops, with per-stop gamut clipping flagged
Harmony view — draggable hue wheel plus monochrome, analogous, complement, split, triad and tetrad schemes, and tintable neutrals
Contrast view — 12×12 matrix in WCAG 2.2 ratios or APCA Lc, with auto-picked text colours per ramp
Live UI preview — a dashboard wired entirely to your tokens, light and dark, that can repaint the studio itself
Export — CSS vars, oklch() CSS, Tailwind JSON, W3C design tokens, SVG and PNG swatch sheets, plus clipboard and file downloads
Share links that carry the whole system in the URL hash, localStorage autosave and named saved systems

interaction.mouse: Drag the ramp sliders and the hue wheel; hover any swatch or matrix cell for its pairing
interaction.click: Click a stop to inspect it (⌥click copies the hex), switch schemes, metrics, themes and export formats
interaction.touch: Everything is touch-driven — the wheel takes a drag, the tab bar and ramp picker scroll horizontally
interaction.keyboard: 1–5 switch views · R shuffles a new system · L copies a share link · S saves it · C copies the current export
